_comment: The output contract of the bible designer (STORYMAKER_AUTHORSHIP_PLAN.md BD.1): what a bible pack may contain. A pack is the same shape as story/schemas/litrpg.json, plus optional seedRows and statChanges. Two engines read THIS file: story/tools/validate_pack.py and StoryMaker's storymaker.applyBiblePack verb (BD.2), so the rules live once, as content. Domain-agnostic on purpose: nothing here assumes fiction (biography.json and a military-campaign pack pass the same rules; docs/PIVOTAL_HISTORY_ENGINE.md §7). DECODER SAFETY: comment keys at this TOP LEVEL ONLY.
_howToRead: patterns are regular expressions. limits are hard: a pack over a limit is refused, never trimmed. reservedKeyPrefixes are packKey prefixes the platform owns (a pack column using one would overwrite a core column). systemKinds are the tables every StoryMaker bible already has; a pack may ADD columns to them, and seed rows into them are keyed on the named key column.
_fieldKindsWhy: formula, rollup and count are derived from other columns and need an expression a pack cannot carry; color has no story use yet. A kind outside this list decodes as 'unknown' in the app and renders read-only, which is never what a designer meant.
_directionsWhy: direction is the machine-readable form of an llmHint like 'Non-decreasing. A crawler never loses a tier.' bible_check (AA.1) reads it; a hint alone is a request, not a rule.
_reservedKindsWhy: change is the Stat Changes table (StoryBibleChanges.swift). Its rows come from statChanges, never from a kind a pack declares.
_keyColumnWhy: Seed rows are matched on the key column so a re-apply adds nothing and an author's own row of the same name is never duplicated. Kinds a pack declares get a Name column first (StoryBibleLedgerStore.enable).
_untilChapterMeans: untilChapter is the chapter where a temporary change STOPS counting (the grid's column is 'Ends in chapter'): poisoned in chapter 5, cured in chapter 7 → 7, so it counts in 5 and 6 and not from 7 on.
_statChangeModesWhy: The words StoryBibleChanges.mode accepts. set = the value is now N; change = add N (negative subtracts); printed = what the page shows, checked against the running total and never added.

nameRules._why: Column names are prompt tokens: the model reads 'Grit: 14', so 'Mana Regeneration Rate' and never mana_regen or manaRegen. All-lowercase single tokens read as slugs; 'Born' and 'URL' are fine, 'grit' is not.

_limitsWhy: alwaysTierFieldsPerKind: an always-tier column is injected into EVERY prompt that mentions the entity; litrpg and biography each spend at most 2. seedRowsPerKind and statChangeRows keep a designed pack a starting point, not an import path (Stat Changes' own size guard is 5,000 rows).
_axesRequiredWhy: A designer pack's designer.axesCovered must name every axis in story/designer/question-banks/. A pack that skipped one was designed with a blank axis (assistants/PATTERNS.md: the trap is a blank axis).
